description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function called 'counter' that provides a counter utility within Smarty templates, allowing for counting with various options such as start value, direction, skip value, and assignment or printing of the counter's value.

methods.name: smarty_function_counter
methods.description: Defines a Smarty plugin function that manages a named counter, allowing configuration of starting point, direction, skip value, and output options.
